_read: All prices read from vuoriclothing.com 21 September 2026. Currency confirmed USD from the product page's schema.org offer ("priceCurrency":"USD") on aim-trouser-athletic-slim-fit-30-khaki-linen-texture, which matched the $98 on the collection tile. Nothing converted.
_traps: The men's golf collection returns 48 tiles but only ~19 distinct styles — Strato Tech Polo alone runs 7 colourways, Aim Short 5, Meta Trouser many. Counting tiles would badly overstate the range.
products.json is blocked store-wide (empty body, not 404), and the collection pages are client-rendered, so the fetch tool returns a shell with zero products. Catalogue had to be read in a browser.
A product page shows $75 (free-shipping threshold) and $24.50 (instalment figure) alongside the real price. Regex-scraping the first dollar figure on a PDP gets the wrong number.

TRADE PRESS VS BRAND COPY: theindustry.fashion and SGI both describe the Aim trousers as having 'scorecard-sized magnetic rear pockets'. Vuori's own product copy says only 'a back pocket with a magnetic closure for easy entry' — no mention of a scorecard, no stated dimension. The magnetic closure is verified; 'scorecard-sized' is not the brand's claim and must not be attributed to them.
Vuori's HQ: CNBC (2023) says Encinitas; TGI's own brands.json says Carlsbad. Needs settling against Vuori's own page before the post states one.
Founding year: CNBC says Kudla quit his job to launch in 2014; brands.json says 2015. Needs settling.
_sources: CNBC Make It — This CEO burned through $700,000 with a simple mistake, 20 March 2023 (verbatim Kudla interview)
